## Problem Set

### Exercise 4.1
Prove hypothetical transitivity using a subproof in Carnap.

~~~{.ProofChecker.ZachTFL}
1. (A \/ B) -> C : PR
2. | A : AS
3. | A \/ B : \/I 2
4. | C : ->E 1, 3
5. A -> C : ->I 2-4
~~~
